knowledge.plain_language_summary: Cast-resin 'sea glass' panels (frosted, 3-4in deep) suspended on a painted metal rod armature wrapping the panel asymmetrically, with VHB-applied frosted-white acrylic letters (replaceable, 2-sided); washed by separate downlight fixtures for a glowing effect.
knowledge.rationale: Translucent cast-resin panels with applied acrylic copy and external wash light give the coastal 'sea glass' theme its glow; VHB copy lets messages change.
